questiontext.text: What are two major plant-based natural fibers commonly used in construction materials, and what properties make them suitable?

generalfeedback.text:
Expected Model Answer

Examples of suitable plant-based natural fibers include jute, sisal, hemp, flax, and coir.

Suitable properties include:

  • High tensile strength
  • Low density (lightweight)
  • Renewable and biodegradable
  • Good thermal and acoustic insulation
  • Low environmental impact
  • Good reinforcement capability in composite materials

Full marks should identify at least two fibers and explain the properties that make them suitable for construction.

questiontext.text: What is a natural fiber composite, and how does combining natural fibers with a matrix material benefit construction applications?

generalfeedback.text:
Expected Model Answer

A natural fiber composite is a material made by combining natural fibers with a matrix material such as polymer, cement, or resin.

The matrix binds the fibers together and transfers loads, while the fibers improve mechanical properties.

Benefits include:

  • Improved strength and stiffness
  • Reduced weight
  • Better crack resistance
  • Improved durability
  • Enhanced sustainability
  • Reduced environmental impact

Full marks should define a natural fiber composite and explain at least two benefits of combining fibers with a matrix.

questiontext.text: Give an example of how natural fiber composites are used in modern building materials and one advantage they offer over traditional materials.

generalfeedback.text:
Expected Model Answer

Examples include:

  • Fiber-reinforced cement boards
  • Wall panels
  • Roofing sheets
  • Insulation panels
  • Composite doors
  • Partition boards

Advantages over traditional materials may include:

  • Lower weight
  • Improved sustainability
  • Reduced carbon footprint
  • Better thermal insulation
  • Improved crack resistance
  • Renewable and biodegradable reinforcement materials

Full marks should provide one appropriate application and explain one clear advantage.
